summary: Implemented print_json in the Rich repo without running code or committing. Changes: new rich/json.py with a JSON renderable (JSON(text) parses a JSON string; JSON.from_data(obj) encodes Python data; both regex-highlight keys, strings, numbers, booleans and null); Console.print_json in rich/console.py (ValueError if both json and data are given; prints with soft_wrap=True); module-level rich.print_json in rich/__init__.py, added to __all__; new json.* styles in rich/default_styles.py; CHANGELOG.md entry under Unreleased. Choices not dictated by the spec: upstream-style signature, regex highlighting rather than the Highlighter classes, and json.loads errors propagate as JSONDecodeError. Not verified: no tests were run and no tests were added. Next steps: run the test suite, try rich.print_json on sample inputs, and add tests/test_json.py.
